title: Into the Void: Understanding Online Health Information in Low-Web Data Languages
reasoning: The paper includes a significant analysis of religious and spiritual content as it pertains to health information seeking. It identifies 'religious content' and 'spiritual terms' (such as 'God', 'Islam', 'evil spell', and 'spirit') as salient components of search results for mental health queries in the studied languages and discusses the role of religious leaders in providing health-related advice.
